note: A1+ Unit 1 Lesson 1.2 rebuilt under the A1+ lesson standards approved 2026-10-27 and the Unit 1 order approved 2026-10-28: one grammar step past A1 (he/she + -s/-es on A1's routine verbs) on a fresh topic, Ana's and Luis's mornings. Source sections: guardrails 'A1+ lesson standards' and 'Unit 1 order'; A1 lessons 4.5 (routine chunks), 3.7 (his/her) and 6.12 (leaves).

lesson.title: 1.2 Two mornings
lesson.unit_outcome: Explain a working day, compare two people’s commitments, check assumptions and account for a change of routine.
lesson.goal: Say what Ana and Luis do in the morning and when, with he/she and the -s ending.
lesson.grammar_function: Third-person -s/-es on A1's routine verbs: I wake up becomes Luis wakes up, I brush my teeth becomes Ana brushes her teeth, I get dressed becomes he gets dressed, I eat breakfast becomes she eats breakfast. Leaves home (A1 leaves, 1.1 leave home) closes each morning and links it to 1.1's workday.
lesson.prerequisite: A1 4.5 routine chunks in the I-form (wake up, brush my teeth, get dressed, eat breakfast), A1 3.7 his/her, he/she, whole hours with at; 1.1 leave home and the times Ana (seven) and Luis (eight) leave.
lesson.speaking_outcome: A clear final /s/ in wakes, gets and eats, and the extra syllable in brushes, inside the complete sentence. Do not require native-like speed.

models.text: I wake up at seven. Luis wakes up at seven.
I wake up at six. Ana wakes up at six.
I get dressed. He gets dressed.
I eat breakfast. She eats breakfast.
